parole.significato: A formal way of addressing a person or people in a formal context or in a starting of a speech, letter, message, memo,…
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Chagatai سایین (sayın, “good, well, distinguished”), from a Mongolic language (compare modern Mongolian сайн (sajn, “good, well”)). Cognate with Persian صائین (sâ'in, toponym of a settlement in Iran).
